arguments.command:
set -euo pipefail
TAG="nothingness_shots"
export DRIVE_TARGET=linux
export DRIVE_RUN_LOG="/tmp/flutter_run_${TAG}.log"
export DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO="/tmp/flutter_input_${TAG}"
export DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME="/tmp/nothingness_${TAG}"
MEDIA_DIR="/opt/nothingness/media"
TRACK="$MEDIA_DIR/10-undercover-47.opus"
.\claude/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py play "$TRACK" >/dev/null
.\claude/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py inspect >/dev/null || true
.\claude/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py shoot before_now_playing_row2 >/dev/null
if .\claude/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py tap void-crumb-jump-to-playing >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sleep 1
  .\claude/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py shoot after_now_playing_row2 >/dev/null
else
  echo "tap not available (glyph hidden)";
fi
ls -la .tmp/agent_shots | grep -E "before_now_playing_row2|after_now_playing_row2" || true

arguments.command:
set -euo pipefail
TAG="nothingness_shots"
export DRIVE_TARGET=linux
export DRIVE_RUN_LOG="/tmp/flutter_run_${TAG}.log"
export DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO="/tmp/flutter_input_${TAG}"
export DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME="/tmp/nothingness_${TAG}"
MEDIA_DIR="/opt/nothingness/media"
TRACK="$MEDIA_DIR/10-undercover-47.opus"
.\claude/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py play "$TRACK" >/dev/null
.\claude/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py inspect >/dev/null || true
.\claude/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py shoot before_now_playing_row2 >/dev/null
if .\claude/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py tap void-crumb-jump-to-playing >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sleep 1
  .\claude/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py shoot after_now_playing_row2 >/dev/null
else
  echo "tap not available (glyph hidden)";
fi
ls -la .tmp/agent_shots | grep -E "before_now_playing_row2|after_now_playing_row2" || true
